A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''slicer''' operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] traveled to [[Artom Station]] with the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] and hacked into the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system of the [[Comet Broom Service]], altering the company's navigational data and planting a [[Trojan programme]] into the system, to aide Ezzar in his plot to incriminate the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as being involved in Comet Broom's [[Cometary Water Reclamation Project]].
